name: REST: Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding (arXiv:2311.08252)
notes: arXiv:2311.08252. REST: Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding. By Zhenyu He et al. Submitted 2023-11-14. Retrieval-based speculative decoding that uses retrieval instead of a draft model. 1.62x-2.36x speedup on 7B and 13B models.
